messages:
Maya: quick ping — noticed our SDK examples and some guides use `prompt_text` while the Console/UI and other docs use `input` and `prompt`. I opened a PR to standardize examples to a single param name (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345). Thoughts on the canonical identifier?
Alex R: saw it. Leaning toward `user_input` since it's explicit and works across text-gen, chat, and embeddings.
Devon: +1 for `user_input`. Note: JS SDK v0.9 uses `prompt`, Python uses `prompt_text`. We'll need migration notes and cross-language examples.
Samir: agree. For UI, can we do a transitional label like "Prompt (API: user_input)" for one release?
Jordan: prefer keeping UI concise. How about keeping "Prompt" in the UI and adding a tooltip: "API param: user_input (formerly prompt_text/prompt)"?
Maya: sounds good. I'll update the PR to rename code snippets to `user_input`, add a migration section, and file a small UI tooltip task.
Alex R: also recommend a short glossary entry: "user_input — the raw text provided by the user; may be a prompt, instruction, or system message." Helps writers choose between prompt/instruction terms.
Devon: I'll draft the glossary blurb and attach it to the PR. Also updating the SDK snippet tests. Example to include:
```js
// before
client.generate({ prompt_text: 'Summarize this text' })

// after
client.generate({ user_input: 'Summarize this text' })
```
Samir: DocsBot, run link-check and snippet-tests on the PR, please. :pray:
DocsBot: CI queued for PR #2345 — running link-check, lint, snippet-tests. Results will post here.
Maya: once CI passes, I'll merge and add a short changelog and a one-paragraph note to the migration guide (v0.9 -> v1.0 param rename).
Jordan: can someone add a release notes checklist so PMs can review the wording?
Alex R: I'll add it to release-notes board and tag @product-review in the PR description.
Maya: Action items: Devon — glossary blurb + updated SDK snippets; Alex — release notes entry + PR description; Samir — UI tooltip ticket; Jordan — review label language. I'll follow up after CI passes. :thumbsup:
